verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a streaming STT API where you hold a handle and push microphone frames into it as they are produced, alongside one-shot `transcribe`. The SDK runs speech models on-device with audio staying on the phone, and VAD is available for detecting speech. Community comments confirm a native on-device STT stage in the pipeline, but none test dictation itself; missing for 10: documented partial/interim result semantics and latency figures for live transcription, independent hands-on corroboration of real-time dictation quality.
